about: What a yoga, pilates or fitness studio may change in the Stillwater design. Protected: the scroll-run class drawn as a clock (a ring that fills phase by phase, the effort traced inside it, a breathing circle at the centre; class.shape draws effort as a flow or as work-and-rest intervals), the timetable with its filters and places left, the passes and calculator, the first-class guide, layout, type and all interaction code. The studio's own words, class, timetable, prices and questions come from the content.
rules: Text may not contain < > { } or line breaks.

class: the example class the hero runs: its length in minutes, how many in the room, shape (flow: effort rises and falls; intervals: work and rest, for strength or HIIT) and the word shown at the end (Namaste, Done, Well done). class.effort: five names for effort, easiest first.
stages: six phases in order that run back to back from 0 to class.length, each with a name, caption, breath cue, its minutes (from, to), effort (1 to 5) and breaths a minute.

timetable: kinds of class (up to six, each gets a colour), and the week's classes: day (0 Monday to 6 Sunday), time (07:00), kind (its number), teacher, length, level, places and places taken. space: what a place is called (mat and mats, spot and spots).

prices.passes: up to three passes, at most one marked intro, each with a price, what it gives (per), a sentence and an optional tag. prices.calc: what the calculator compares a month at a time: the drop-in price, a pack (classes and price) and a monthly membership, with their three names.
first: what to bring (up to five) and up to six questions with answers.
